description: Stream Live IPTV, Video On-Demand, and Series from an Xtream-compatible server using this plugin. Fork of Kevinjil/Jellyfin.Xtream for Jellyfin 12.
name: Jellyfin Xtream
overview: Stream content from an Xtream-compatible server.

versions.changelog: 0.11.0: Nightly 'Index Xtream catalog' task: from 1:00 to 6:00 it opens the selected categories one at a time, with a random pause of 3 to 10 minutes, so that the Jellyfin search finds every movie and series (at most one provider request per category, none when the list is cached). Episode titles, overviews and air dates taken from TMDB, without any provider request (the TMDB id of the series comes from its cached details). 0.10.2: Fewer provider requests. Each channel keeps its guide on disk and asks for it again only when less than one day of programs is left, one request every 500 ms. Catalog prefetched at startup and every 3 days, lists fresh for 3 days. Movies take their TMDB id from the list, so their overview and images come from TMDB: the provider is asked for the details of a movie only when it is refreshed by hand. Series details one request per second at most. 'Refresh catalog' and 'Refresh guide' buttons on the plugin page. 0.10.0: Category folders (rules 'Name: KEY1, KEY2' group the VOD and Series categories, tags removed from their names); 'FR - Title' language prefixes become tags. Prefetch task (nightly and at startup) loads the selected categories into the cache, now fresh for 24 hours. Guide refresh protected: channels without a guide id are skipped, guide paused after 5 failures in a row, 15 s timeout. All queries paused for 10 minutes when the provider refuses one (401, 403, 429, 444, connection refused) instead of retrying. Live channels without a name no longer abort the channel list. 0.9.x: Jellyfin 12.3 support, playback fix (media sources carry the item identifier), resilient queries with a memory and disk cache, custom folder names.
